article.story: ITHACA, N.Y. -- — Jax Abalos’ 13 points helped Cornell defeat Keuka 99-59 on Sunday. Abalos shot 4 for 7 (3 for 6 from 3-point range) and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Big Red (2-1). Quinn Gibson added 11 points while shooting 5 of 9 from the field and 1 for 4 from the line while he also had 10 rebounds. Kaleb Nutifafa finished with 17 points for the Wolves. Up next Cornell visits Saint Bonaventure in its next matchup on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
